title: v6 calibration: observations, baseline comparison and assay limits

invasion.note: Each direction establishes its own resident. Both strategies are exact clones, introduced as independent origins. Invaders are external biomass recorded by injectLife. Local light/depth/vents still vary; mixed means the normal spatial world, not uniform resources. Initial introduction must be <=10% to be described as rare. Resident establishment for 1,200 steps is not proof of ecological equilibrium.

metricNotes.time: Simulation steps; neither years nor generations. maxLivingGeneration describes living agents at that checkpoint.
metricNotes.effectiveLabels: exp(Shannon entropy) over current classification labels; this is not a biological species count or a coexistence test.
metricNotes.origins: Independent initial reproductive systems; loss of origins and branching labels are different quantities.
metricNotes.feeding: Use sharedFeedingMetric for v5/v6 comparison. It includes decaying records from deceased organisms; e-folding time is 600 steps. Amounts are net intake flows, not external energy inputs. The v6-only individual metric covers currently living agents. Prey intake can include within-label predation.
metricNotes.colonies: livingWithColonyTrait includes one-cell carriers; physicalGroups counts organisms with cells > 1. v5 physicalGroups is null because that model has no cell-number lifecycle.
metricNotes.structureInheritance: A transmitting birth is not a fitness estimate. Parent counts include incomplete lifetimes. Selected structures missing from the original filtered table have zero recorded carriers/gains.
metricNotes.numerics: Audit peaks and maximum balance residuals are sampled every 120 steps, with final/stop samples. They are not continuous maxima.

supported: All four v6 long runs reached T12000 without the computation capacity being reached.
Realized intake uses more detritus and several sources than the v5 baseline under the shared network metric.
All four v6 runs recorded colony-trait inheritance and had some physically multicellular organisms at T12000.
All 40 synthetic colony/tissue monoculture conditions completed maturation and reproduction and retained living descendants at T1500.
notEstablished: Stable ecological coexistence is not demonstrated. Effective label diversity at T12000 was lower than v5 in three of four sampled worlds.
No recorded tissue, bilateral or radial innovation appeared in the four default v6 runs by T12000.

All valid finite rare-introduction assays in this batch failed to show an increase from the initial eight invaders; other directions were not rare or lacked a surviving resident. This does not establish universal competitive exclusion.
Synthetic-clone lifecycle feasibility does not demonstrate spontaneous emergence, competitive advantage or long-term persistence of complex morphology.
interpretationLimits: Only four world seeds and two assay seeds were used; no statistical population-level claim is made.
The versions change multiple mechanisms, genome length, founding genotypes and random trajectories. Matching a seed does not isolate a mechanism effect.
The v6 worlds produced different numbers of births and generations; equal horizons do not imply equal evolutionary opportunities.
Most living individuals still obtain more than half their observed intake from photosynthesis. Multiple food sources do not by themselves establish separate stable feeding guilds.
ORIGIN shape means for length and thickness approach their upper bounds, indicating a body-size tradeoff that still needs calibration.
A fixed 1200-step resident phase is not an equilibrium test; eight initial invaders are not rare when only a few residents survive.

colonyFeasibility.design: For each seed, light condition and repeat-gene value, separate worlds contain only single cells, colony carriers or colony+tissue carriers. All have pigment. Genomes and all other shape values are identical. Founders begin as one cell and pay their own growth costs. Initial cells are exact clones distributed over aquatic field centres; no random founding gene perturbation is used.
notes: Monocultures use a synthetic light-specialist genotype carrying pigment.

There are two seed replicates per condition; the five single-cell controls differ only in shape[3] and give identical outcomes within a seed/environment, so they must not be treated as five independent replicates.
Mutation is disabled and all structures are fixed at founding, so structural mutation-eligibility thresholds do not operate in this assay.
